notes: ENDLUME STUDIO 8.55 strict render release, pinned to exact gated source 23cb01908604cf7583843c1b1bf74eafa7205a69. For the one-image workflow it locks exact 1920x1080, 60 FPS and H.265; forces whole-track duration so a song already playing at the nominal 2-hour boundary always finishes; disables crossfade, normalization and ambient processing; requires original MP3 bitstream-copy and refuses the strict path if source MP3 parameters cannot be preserved. It fixes the zero-Subscribe regression that forced the slow physical 2-3GB fallback by adding a 30-second zero-copy master path, keeps the existing periodic Subscribe zero-copy path, and enforces the 400-700 MB container envelope without modifying audio/video packets. The VYRON handoff implementation is preserved and re-tested, including selectedProjectIds, sourceManifestPath, newest-first inbox handling and status reporting. The M1 candidate gate passed TypeScript/Vite build, cargo check, MP4 manifest tests and all five VYRON bridge tests before promotion. No unrelated application functionality is intentionally changed.
